title.narrative: Expanded and reinforced Social Protection Floors at the policy and programmatic level as per the commitment of AU Member States

description.narrative: Africa has demonstrated strong political commitment to sustainable development and poverty reduction through various social protection policies. The AU Agenda 2063 aims to ensure a high standard of living and well-being for all citizens, with a focus on affordable social security. The ILO Centenary Declaration and the 2019 Abidjan Declaration support the expansion of sustainable social protection. In 2021, the AUC and ILO introduced the Africa Regional Social Protection Strategy 2021-2025 (ARSPS 2021-2025) to increase social protection coverage to 40% by 2025. Despite these initiatives, Africa's social protection coverage remains the lowest globally at around 20%. The 2024/25 work stream aims to address the root causes of social protection gaps identified in ARSPS 2021-2025. The goal is to implement a gender-responsive social protection strategy to achieve SDG target 1.3, aligning with the 2019 Abidjan Declaration, the Global Accelerator on Jobs and Social Protection, and the Global Coalition for Social Justice. The program focuses on consultations, advocacy, capacity building, and developing knowledge products and research
